dedupe_keys.name: coudlabs wp8 t812 udc 001 identifying sediment deposits from temperature signals

description: Anta, Jose at Universidade da Coruña publishes high-resolution temperature observations from water and saturated drainage-sediment mixtures through Co-UDlabs. The experimental campaign examines differences between water-phase temperatures and temperatures at the bottom of sediment deposits. These measurements support a thermal approach to identifying bed material and estimating accumulation within urban drainage systems. Coverage is the UDC Joint Research Activity campaign in Spain; dates, sensor frequency and sediment-depth range are not stated. Zenodo provides a data ZIP and a PDF campaign description with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the source establishes a method-development experiment, not a continuously validated field sensor product, and thermal properties influence transfer to other sediment mixtures. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
